validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. P6718 is the 'pipeline 4' (EWGP-4) line of MGS-3 Package 3, the EWPS-1-to-Shedgum 56-inch gas pipeline. Independently described by MEED (Package 3, EWPS-1 to Shedgum, 56-inch), BlackRidge Research (Package 3: 'Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-1 to Shedgum (56km)... two parallel transmission lines'), and DMS Projects (dedicated Package-3 EWPS-1-to-Shedgum project page). Not GEM-derived; not a hallucination. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed gas transmission (dry/sales gas). BlackRidge: the MGS network 'transports sales gas across the kingdom' to convert power plants from oil to gas; pipeline-journal confirms 56-inch non-sour east-to-west gas transmission. Correctly recorded as Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission. NOT NGL, NOT gathering. DUPLICATE: NOT an error. P6717 (segment '3') and P6718 (segment '4') are the two parallel 56-inch lines of the single EWPS-1-Shedgum corridor (DMS/MEED scope: 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines 3 and 4 from EWPS-1 to Shedgum, covering 56 kilometres'). GEM correctly split the 56 km corridor into two ~28 km parallel lines. They are twin lines, not a relabel/double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Aramco 100% owner - confirmed (BlackRidge: 'Saudi Aramco owns the system'). SPEC: Diameter 56 in - confirmed by 3 independent sources. LengthKnown 28 km/line - confirmed (56 km corridor / 2 lines; MEED lists EWPS-1-Shedgum as 56 km total). SegmentCost $46m USD - confirmed as the per-line half of the $91.89m / 344,614,412 SAR Gas Arabian Package 3 (Shedgum-to-EWPS-1) EPC contract (Zawya: 40-month timeline). Status=construction - confirmed (construction commenced Q2 2024). StartYear1=2028 - confirmed as the in-service year (BlackRidge: 'Project Completion Date Q4 2028'); correct usage. CAVEAT: the only soft point is that '28 km' and '$46m' are derived as exactly half of the corridor-level figures (56 km, $91.89m) rather than independently published per-line numbers; the per-line split is GEM's reasonable allocation, well-supported but not separately sourced.

fills.researcher_notes: Endpoints were blank (only StartCountry/EndCountry = Saudi Arabia recorded). Both MEED and BlackRidge name the line explicitly as running from EWPS-1 (East-West Pump Station 1) to Shedgum (the Shedgum gas plant hub). Filled StartLocation=EWPS-1, EndLocation=Shedgum with paired Location [ref].

summary: P6718 confirmed (caveat): real, correctly classified MGS-3 Package 3 EWPS-1->Shedgum 56-in gas transmission line (EWGP-4 twin of P6717); 56/28km, $46m=half of $91.89m Gas Arabian contract, Aramco, Q4 2028 all corroborated by >=2 independent sources; endpoints filled.
